rules.title: Relocation Assistance for No-Fault Evictions Under RSO & JCO
rules.quote: All tenant not-at-fault evictions require payment of relocation assistance and the filing of a Declaration of Intent to Evict form with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) before evicting tenants from units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO).
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance and file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD before evicting tenants for no-fault reasons under the RSO or JCO.
rules.coverage_text: units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration with the LAHD makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO

rules.title: Relocation Assistance Payment Amounts for Eligible Tenants (Less Than 3 Years)
rules.quote: Eligible Household $11,000 [for] Tenants with Less Than 3 Years
rules.summary: Eligible tenants with less than 3 years of tenancy receive $11,000 in relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
rules.coverage_text: units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
rules.exemption_note: Reduced to $10,550 for Mom & Pop properties (4 or fewer units) for owner/family occupancy evictions only; reduced to one month's rent for single-family dwellings owned by natural persons under JCO

rules.title: Relocation Assistance Payment Amounts for Eligible Tenants (3 or More Years or Low Income)
rules.quote: Eligible Household $14,400 [for] Tenants with Length of Tenancy of 3 or More Years, or Low Income at or below 80% AMI (Low Income)
rules.summary: Eligible tenants with 3 or more years of tenancy or with income at or below 80% AMI receive $14,400 in relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.summary: Qualified tenants (age 62+, disabled, or with minor children) with less than 3 years of tenancy receive $23,150 in relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.title: Enhanced Relocation Assistance for Extremely Low Income Tenants Displaced by Demolition for New Construction
rules.citation: Los Angeles Municipal Code §§ 188481, 188482 (Resident Protections Ordinance)
rules.quote: Tenants Displaced by New Development $115,480 [for] Extremely Low Income
rules.summary: Extremely low income tenants (30% AMI or below) displaced by demolition for new construction of Protected Units receive $115,480 in relocation assistance under the Resident Protections Ordinance.
rules.effective_date_evidence: City laws require all tenants be paid relocation assistance in the amounts required by the RSO or JCO within 15 days of serving a notice to terminate tenancy, which must be enhanced for lower income tenants if the project is subject to the Resident Protections Ordinance (RPO), effective 2/11/2025 under Ordinances # 188481 and #188482.
rules.coverage_text: Protected Units demolished for the purpose of new construction
rules.exemption_note: Applies only to lower income tenants displaced by demolition for new construction of Protected Units under the Resident Protections Ordinance
rules.penalty: Failure to comply with the RPO may result in financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances

rules.title: Relocation Assistance Payment Timing
rules.quote: Payment shall be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction
rules.summary: Landlords must provide relocation assistance payment to tenants within 15 days of serving the written notice of eviction.
rules.coverage_text: units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
rules.exemption_note: Landlord may elect to pay through an escrow account at their sole discretion and cost

rules.title: Relocation Assistance Offset for Accumulated Rent
rules.quote: A landlord may offset the tenant's accumulated rent against any relocation assistance, unless the relocation assistance is owed because a termination of tenancy is required by a governmental agency order to vacate or comply with an issued order for an unpermitted dwelling.
rules.summary: Landlords may offset tenants' accumulated rent debt against relocation assistance payments, except when eviction is required by a government order to vacate or comply for an unpermitted dwelling.
rules.coverage_text: units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) or the Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
